labs.title: Word frequency with Hash + Enumerable
labs.goal: Count word frequencies and print words that appear more than once, sorted alphabetically as `word:count` lines — classic Hash + Enumerable muscle memory.
steps: Tally counts in a Hash (or use each_with_object).
Select keys with count > 1, sort, and print word:count.
labs.starterCode:
text = "ruby ruby java rust ruby java"
# TODO: print words with count > 1 as word:count, sorted
puts text
labs.solution:
text = "ruby ruby java rust ruby java"
freq = text.split.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) { |w, h| h[w] += 1 }
freq.keys.select { |w| freq[w] > 1 }.sort.each do |w|
  puts "#{w}:#{freq[w]}"
end

labs.title: Comparable value class
labs.goal: Implement `<=>` and include Comparable so Version objects sort and compare with `<` / `>` — the standard mixin pattern.
steps: Define Version with major and minor readers.
include Comparable and implement <=> comparing [major, minor].
Print whether 1.2 < 1.10 and the sorted list.
labs.starterCode:
class Version
  attr_reader :major, :minor
  def initialize(major, minor)
    @major = major
    @minor = minor
  end
  # TODO: Comparable + <=>
  def to_s = "#{major}.#{minor}"
end

versions = [Version.new(1, 10), Version.new(1, 2), Version.new(2, 0)]
puts (Version.new(1, 2) < Version.new(1, 10))
puts versions.sort.map(&:to_s).join(", ")
labs.solution:
class Version
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :major, :minor
  def initialize(major, minor)
    @major = major
    @minor = minor
  end
  def <=>(other)
    [major, minor] <=> [other.major, other.minor]
  end
  def to_s = "#{major}.#{minor}"
end

versions = [Version.new(1, 10), Version.new(1, 2), Version.new(2, 0)]
puts (Version.new(1, 2) < Version.new(1, 10))
puts versions.sort.map(&:to_s).join(", ")

labs.title: Custom each with yield
labs.goal: Build a tiny collection that mixes in Enumerable by implementing `each` with `yield` — how Ruby iterators really work.
steps: Store items in an array inside Bag.
Implement each that yields each item and returns self (or an Enumerator).
labs.starterCode:
class Bag
  def initialize(*items) = @items = items
  # TODO: include Enumerable, implement each
end

b = Bag.new("a", "b", "c")
puts b.map(&:upcase).join(",")
labs.solution:
class Bag
  include Enumerable
  def initialize(*items) = @items = items

  def each(&block)
    return enum_for(:each) unless block_given?
    @items.each(&block)
    self
  end
end

b = Bag.new("a", "b", "c")
puts b.map(&:upcase).join(",")

labs.solution:
Result = Struct.new(:success, :value, :error)

class CreateUser
  def self.call(**args) = new(**args).call

  def initialize(name:, email:)
    @name = name
    @email = email
  end

  def call
    return Result.new(false, nil, "email required") if @email.to_s.empty?

    user = { id: 1, name: @name, email: @email.downcase }
    Result.new(true, user, nil)
  end
end

result = CreateUser.call(name: "Ada", email: "ADA@EXAMPLE.COM")
if result.success
  puts "created #{result.value[:name]} <#{result.value[:email]}>"
else
  puts "error: #{result.error}"
end
